verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an installable plugin/connector ecosystem (e.g., 'Install the Slack plugin', 'Install the Codex Security plugin', plugins connecting to Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, Gong, and addable MCP servers like Context7), implying a catalog power-users can pick from and add. However, there's no explicit description of a browsable 'directory' or marketplace UI, nor independent/hands-on confirmation of the browsing experience. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a searchable/browsable app directory UI, and independent user reports of discovering/adding apps via that directory.
